The Bank of Canada changed its policy rate **4 times in 2025**. Each change was a 25 bp cut.

- **Start of year:** 3.25% (1 Jan 2025).
- **End of year:** 2.25% (31 Dec 2025).

The series dates each new rate on the first business day it applies, which is the day after the announcement. The new levels first appear on these dates:

| Date in series | New rate |
|---|---|
| 30 Jan | 3.00% |
| 13 Mar | 2.75% |
| 18 Sep | 2.50% |
| 30 Oct | 2.25% |

The rate stayed at 2.75% from 13 Mar through 17 Sep. I did not see every daily value between 1 May and 10 Jun. The 1 May to 29 Aug window had a minimum and maximum of 2.75%, so no change fell in it.

Source: Bank of Canada Valet, series V39079 (target for the overnight rate, business daily), reference period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. This is a Bank of Canada series, so there is no Statistics Canada table ID.
